disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi: passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānan'ti?
evaṃ mayaṃ aññam'aññaṃ guttā aññam'aññaṃ rakkhitā sippāni c'eva dassessāma, lābhañ'ca lacchāma, sotthinā ca caṇḍālavaṃsā orohissāmā'ti.
atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami.

pubb'eva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato etadahosi, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca.

apucchi, ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya, ko hetu ko paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya, ko hetu ko paccayo saññākkhandhassa paññāpanāya, ko hetu ko paccayo saṅkhārakkhandhassa paññāpanāya, ko hetu ko paccayo viññāṇakkhandhassa paññāpanāyā'ti?
agocare, bhikkhave, carataṃ paravisaye lacchati māro otāraṃ, lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
na h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, atthasaṃhitaṃ n'ādibrahmacariyakaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, tasmā taṃ mayā anakkhātaṃ.

yo, bhikkhave, tathāgatena evaṃ ācikkhiyamāne desiyamāne paññapiyamāne paṭṭhapiyamāne vivariyamāne vibhajiyamāne uttānīkariyamāne na jānāti na passati tam'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ puthujjanaṃ andhaṃ acakkhukaṃ ajānantaṃ apassantaṃ kin'ti karomi!
taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti,
atthi, bhikkhave, himavato pabbatarājassa duggā visamā desā, yattha n'eva makkaṭānaṃ cārī na manussānaṃ.
ekaṃ ekakaṃ, dve dukā, tīṇi tikā, cattāri catukkā, pañca pañcakā, cha chakkā, satta sattakā, aṭṭha aṭṭhakā, nava navakā, dasa dasakā'ti
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, mahārukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.

n'eva davaya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya, iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā'ti.
upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajja't'agge pāṇ'upetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'ti.
dīpañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi dīpagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ.
api ca me, bhante, madhurakajāto viya kāyo, disā'pi me na pakkhāyanti, dhammā'pi maṃ nappaṭibhanti bhagavato gelaññena.
diṭṭho me, bhante, bhagavato phāsu, diṭṭhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato khamanīyaṃ, diṭṭhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato yāpanīyaṃ.
divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehi,
gamissanti, bhante, gāvo vacchagiddhiniyo'ti.
idha, bhikkhu, gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā tesu yogaṃ āpajjati.
atha kho bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhamitvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
idh'ev'āhaṃ veḷuvagāmake vassaṃ upagacchāmī'ti.

kacci mayaṃ, bhante, evaṃ puṭṭhā evaṃ byākaramānā vuttavādino c'eva bhagavato homa, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhāma, dhammassa c'ānudhammaṃ byākaroma, na ca koci sahadhammiko vād'ānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatī'ti?
tass'ime satta bojjh'aṅge bhāvayato kām'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhav'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijj'āsavā'pi cittaṃ vimuccati.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, dakkho assadammako bhaddaṃ ass'ājānīyaṃ labhitvā paṭhamen'eva mukh'ādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāreti, atha uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti,
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, himavantaṃ pabbatarājānaṃ nissāya nāgā kāyaṃ vaḍḍhenti, balaṃ gāhenti, te tattha kāyaṃ vaḍḍhetvā balaṃ gāhetvā kusobbhe otaranti
kudāssu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassā”ti?
ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakyesu viharati nagarakaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.
yaṃ kho idaṃ anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ dukkhaṃ loke uppajjati jarāmaraṇaṃ, idaṃ nu kho dukkhaṃ kiṃnidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃjātikaṃ kiṃpabhavaṃ?
pivato hi kho taṃ chādessati vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi, pivitvā ca pana tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhanti.
evaṃ hi so, bhikkhave, dārukkhandho samuddaninno bhavissati samuddapoṇo samuddapabbhāro.
ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yaṃ tiṭṭhat'eva nibbānaṃ, tiṭṭhati nibbānagāmī maggo, tiṭṭhati bhavaṃ gotamo samādapetā,
no kallo pañho'ti bhagavā avoca, āhāretī'ti ahaṃ na vadāmi.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto ajjhokāse nisinno hoti.

att'atthaṃ vā hi, bhikkhave, sampassamānena alam'eva appamādena sampādetuṃ, paraṃ atthaṃ vā hi, bhikkhave, sampassamānena alam'eva appamādena sampādetuṃ, ubhay'atthaṃ vā hi, bhikkhave, sampassamānena alam'eva appamādena sampādetun'ti.
idha no, bhante, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā amhe evaṃ pucchanti, kim'atthiyaṃ, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti?
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti,
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno kāyagatā sati abhāvitā abahulīkatā, taṃ cakkhu āviñchati manāpiyesu rūpesu, amanāpiyā rūpā paṭikūlā honti
pivato hi kho taṃ chādessati vaṇṇena'pi gandhena'pi rasena'pi, pivitvā ca pana tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti.
tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto ajjhokāse nisinno hoti.
atha kho so, bhikkhave, rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā taṃ nagaraṃ māpeyya.
sādhu sādhu, bhikkhave, evam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, n'etaṃ aññathā.
mayam'pi kira, bho, aniccā addhuvā asassatā sakkāyapariyāpannā'ti.
vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāy'ānupassino viharatha ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ek'aggacittā, kāyassa yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāya
pubb'eva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato etadahosi, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca.
ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yadidaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya satta bojjh'aṅge bhāvento satta bojjh'aṅge bahulīkaronto mahantattaṃ vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesu.

idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, iti'pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā'ti.
atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo.
taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
chandarāgo bhagavato n'atthi. suvimuttacitto bhagavā.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānam'indo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti,
yo'pi hetu, yo'pi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya, so'pi anicco.
so sammasamāno evaṃ jānāti, upadhi taṇhānidāno taṇhāsamudayo taṇhājātiko taṇhāpabhavo, taṇhāya sati upadhi hoti, taṇhāya asati upadhi na hotī'ti.
pañcupādānakkhandhātissa vacanīyaṃ, seyyath'īdaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.
so vata, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvento ariyaṃ aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaronto sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatīti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

idha, gahapati, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, iti'pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā'ti.
